Rheumatology Follow-up
Patient: Kenji Quintero | DOB: 09/19/1968 | MRN: SYN-3356401
Date of service: 10/22/2025 | Dr. Sanne Langley, MD (Rheumatology)

History:
57-year-old man with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2020, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: type 2 diabetes, hyperlipidemia.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
Inadequate response to methotrexate 15 mg weekly for 24 weeks despite good adherence.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: seropositive rheumatoid arthritis, DAS28-CRP 4.3 (moderate disease activity).
Pre-biologic screening: tuberculosis and hepatitis B screens negative.
Plan: start fictimab 160 mg subcutaneously every 14 days.
